items.title: # Craft Guest List
items.content: Generate a guest list for a [age/type] birthday party for [person's name]. Include family, close friends, and [number] additional guests. Draft a simple invitation message for digital delivery.

items.title: # Plan Party Theme
items.content: Suggest 3 unique birthday party themes for a [age/person's interest] celebration. For each theme, list 3 decoration ideas and 2 simple food suggestions.

items.title: # Organize Party Fun
items.content: Create a menu for a [age/type] birthday party for [number] guests, including main dishes, snacks, and a dessert. Also, suggest 3 engaging activities or games suitable for this group.

items.title: # Master Party Budget
items.content: Generate a detailed birthday party planning checklist for a [age/type] celebration, covering tasks from 4 weeks out to the day of. Include a simple budget template with common expense categories.

items.title: # Create Animal Tale
items.content: Write a short bedtime story about a [animal] named [name] who learns to [lesson]. Make it suitable for a [age] year old. Include 3 simple characters.

items.title: # Design Adventure Story
items.content: Generate a bedtime adventure story set in [setting, e.g., a magical forest]. The main character is [character type, e.g., a brave squirrel] and they are looking for [object]. Keep it gentle and fun

items.title: # Personalize Dream Story
items.content: Create a sweet bedtime story for a child named [Child's Name]. Include their favorite things: [favorite toy], [favorite food], and [favorite animal]. The story should be about a happy dream they have.

items.title: # Interactive Sleep Story
items.content: Write a short, interactive bedtime story where the child makes simple choices. Start with 'Once upon a time, [character]...' and offer two choices at the end of each paragraph. Keep it under 500

items.title: # The Funny Bestman
items.content: Write a humorous wedding speech for [Name]. Use these stories: [Story 1, Story 2]. Keep it lighthearted, avoid inside jokes, and end with a sincere toast.

items.title: # Heartfelt Parent Toast
items.content: Write a touching speech from a [Parent] to [Child]. Focus on [Trait/Memory]. Tone: emotional and proud. Length: 3-5 minutes speaking time.

items.title: # Sweet Maid Honor
items.content: Draft a warm speech for [Name]. Describe our friendship using [Example]. Highlight why [Partner] is a great match. Make it feel natural and supportive.

items.title: # Short Groom Thanks
items.content: Write a brief thank-you speech for the groom. Thank [People/Groups] and share a short, sweet compliment about [Partner]. Keep it under 2 minutes.

items.title: # Plan Any Event
items.content: Generate a comprehensive checklist for planning a [Type of Event, e.g., corporate conference, birthday party, wedding] for [Number] guests. Include pre-event, day-of, and post-event tasks.

items.title: # Master Event Budget
items.content: Create a detailed budget checklist for a [Type of Event, e.g., charity gala, product launch] with an estimated budget of [Amount]. List categories like venue, catering, entertainment, marketing, and

items.title: # Choose Best Vendors
items.content: Provide a checklist for selecting vendors for a [Type of Event, e.g., music festival, family reunion]. Include criteria for caterers, photographers, entertainment, and venue suppliers, plus questions

items.title: # Promote Your Event
items.content: Develop a marketing and promotion checklist for a [Type of Event, e.g., online webinar, local fair] targeting [Target Audience]. Include digital, social media, and traditional outreach strategies.

items.title: # Design Survey Questions
items.content: Generate 10 clear, unbiased survey questions about [Topic] for a general audience. Focus on gathering actionable insights without leading respondents.

items.title: # Target Audience Insights
items.content: Design 8 survey questions to understand [Audience]'s opinions on [Product/Service]. Ensure questions are relevant and easy for this demographic to answer.

items.title: # Gather Product Feedback
items.content: Create 7 concise survey questions for user feedback on [Website/App Feature]. Include questions about satisfaction, ease of use, and areas for improvement.

items.title: # Explore User Experiences
items.content: Develop 5 open-ended survey questions to explore users' experiences with [Topic/Event]. Aim for detailed, qualitative responses that reveal their perspectives.

items.title: # Create Buyer Persona
items.content: Generate a detailed buyer persona for [Product/Service] targeting [Target Demographic]. Include demographics, pain points, goals, and preferred communication channels.

items.title: # Identify Customer Pains
items.content: Create a customer persona for [Industry/Niche]. Focus on their top 3 challenges, how they currently solve them, and what an ideal solution looks like.

items.title: # Develop Marketing Angle
items.content: Based on [Product/Service], describe a customer persona most receptive to its benefits. Detail their interests, online behavior, and key motivators.

items.title: # Map User Journey
items.content: Outline a customer persona for [Specific Scenario, e.g., first-time homebuyer]. Detail their journey from initial need to purchase, including touchpoints and emotions.

items.title: # Define Startup Problem
items.content: Create a slide for a startup pitch deck that clearly outlines the [Target Audience]'s main problem and how [Your Solution] solves it. Keep it concise.

items.title: # Show Market Size
items.content: Generate a pitch deck slide detailing the total addressable market (TAM) for [Your Product/Service]. Include key statistics and growth potential for [Industry].

items.title: # Explain Revenue Plan
items.content: Draft a slide explaining the business model for [Your Startup]. Describe how revenue will be generated, including pricing strategy and key channels.

items.title: # Introduce Your Team
items.content: Outline a pitch deck slide introducing the core team members of [Your Startup], highlighting their relevant experience. Also, state the 'ask' (e.g., funding amount and use).
